outcome: Use a range of techniques to record observations in sketchbooks, journals and other media.
Use those records as a basis for exploring ideas.
Use a range of techniques and media, including painting.
Handle different materials with growing proficiency.
Analyse and evaluate your own work and that of others.
Use evaluation to strengthen the visual impact or application of your work.
Learn the history of art, craft, design and architecture, from ancient times to today.
Recognise periods, styles and major movements, and judge artists, architects and designers with reasons.
